thread:
maria (partner-eng): Heads-up — we need to lock down ISV sandbox access + model licensing before the next marketplace push. quick ask: who needs private model weights vs just API access?
devin (sdks): LangChain and LlamaIndex teams want a sandbox where connectors can exercise local model endpoints (for perf tests). they mentioned using quantized checkpoints in the bundle.
ash (typo corrected) ash (product): we should split two flows: 1) 'bundled' connectors that include weights (requires license & distro checks) and 2) 'gateway' adapters that call hosted/dedicated APIs (just contractual usage).
nate (pm): timeline wise — if weight-bundles need legal signoff, that adds ~2 weeks. can we do gated sandbox onboarding so partner demos don't block release?
sarah (legal): correct — model license types matter. permissive OSS (MIT/BSD/Apache) is easy. models with non-commercial or proprietary clauses need review and likely a partner addendum. also check dataset licenses if they re-distribute.
maria (partner-eng): action: create mapping doc of partner -> desired flow (bundle vs api) + model name + license. I'll start a Notion page and share.
devin (sdks): dropped a quick checklist we can use:
```
- partner name
- connector type (bundle|gateway)
- model ids used
- preview-only? (yes/no)
- requires HW (GPU) in sandbox?
- legal notes
- marketing assets ready?
```
maria (partner-eng): perfect. also add 'co-announcement assets' and 'launch embargo date' to that checklist.
ash ash (product): for sandbox infra: recommend ephemeral VPC peered env + sample workload runners. we can provide a small Dedicated dev pool (p3-equivalent) for perf.
nate (pm): co-marketing ask: partners want joint blog + demo video. who owns socials? marketing will. need assets timeline plugged into the checklist.
maria (partner-eng): @integrations-bot can you provision one sandbox for "LangChain-Flow"? tag it as "partner-sandbox-llc" and set expiry 30 days.
integrations-bot: provisioning request received for partner-sandbox-llc. queue id: q_9842. approx ETA 3 hours. :gear:
devin (sdks): one more — model licensing ops: if partner bundles a quantized model, do we handle the quantization tooling or they ship pre-quantized?
sarah (legal): legal side doesn't care about quantization tech, only redistribution rights and attribution. engineering should decide ops model.
ash ash (product): ops preference is partners ship pre-quantized artifact with a signed manifest.json (hash + provenance). we can provide a simple validator script.
devin (sdks): dropping validator snippet:
```bash
# validate-manifest.sh
jq -e '.model_hash and .license' manifest.json || exit 1
# verify checksum
sha256sum -c model.sha256 || exit 1
```
maria (partner-eng): nice. adding that to the onboarding doc.
nate (pm): do we need partner legal to sign a marketplace listing agreement separate from the licensing addendum?
sarah (legal): yes — two docs: 1) marketplace listing TOS (standard), 2) licensing addendum (if redistributing weights). both e-sign.
maria (partner-eng): ok — next steps: I will 1) publish Notion mapping + checklist by EOD, 2) @integrations-bot will provision sandbox for LangChain-Flow, 3) product/eng to prepare validator + dev pool config, 4) legal to draft addendum template.
nash ash (product): will scope the dev pool and share config snippets here.
devin (sdks): I can stub the connector README + sample code for the marketplace tile.
maria (partner-eng): bonus: partners asked whether we can offer co-bundled private model testing in Dedicated customers — that is a separate sales motion but good to flag for dedicated sales leads.
nate (pm): adding a calendar invite for a sync Thursday 9am PT.
sarah (legal): flagged potential redline on noncommercial clause for one partner. will DM specifics.
integrations-bot: sandbox q_9842 provision complete — partner-sandbox-llc ready at https://sandboxes.redwood.ai/q_9842 (expires in 30 days). :tada:
maria (partner-eng): beautiful — thanks team. I'll post Notion link in this thread when done. :thumbsup:
